verdict.rationale: Generating AI output from a user's own data is the core of this product. The docs show the model can use your own data as input through file search and retrieval, function calling to external systems, and text generation ([gpt-docs-29], [gpt-docs-19], [gpt-docs-7], [gpt-docs-1]). Structured Outputs can shape the insights into schema-conformant results ([gpt-docs-6]). One hands-on report found that results from piped-in data were inconsistent and non-deterministic ([gpt-comm-9]), which tempers confidence. Missing for 10: no turnkey in-product insights or suggestions surface (developers must build the experience themselves), no in-depth documentation of insight or analysis workflows over user data, and no independent corroboration of insight quality.
